summary: Removable chips: deleting one drops it from the list, and a reset link appears when all are gone.
use: Tag inputs and filter pills the user can remove, with a way to restore them.
spec: `{#each tags as tag (tag)}` renders `<Chip label={tag} deletable ondelete={() => (tags = tags.filter((t) => t !== tag))} />`
`{#if tags.length === 0}` shows a `<button class="reset" type="button"` labelled Reset tags
